simple.meaning: עֲזַזְיָהוּ (ʻĂzazyâhûw) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.

timeline.evidenceText: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
